clue.text: Very old client, I hope half 18

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

indicators.note: half means only the first two letters of hope are used

clue.text: Abstract painter's mood wanting a way that describes later works?

definitions.meaning: a point on a battery or circuit where a wire is attached
fatal, as of an illness that will end in death

parts.note: reads as a lively crossword clue, but means a cartoon character famous for following clues to solve mysteries

clue.text: Cut round fruit, though react as if an onion?

a date is the fruit of the date palm

explanation.definitionFit: Cutting an onion makes the eyes water, so to weep a drop is to respond the way one does to an onion.

indicators.note: primarily means first of all, so only the opening letter of Aintree is taken

parts.note: a Scot is a national of Scotland

indicators.note: ireless means without ire, so those three letters are removed

parts.note: a squire is a country landowner
iffy means doubtful or uncertain

clue.text: Running problem with memoranda, two pages found in river

parts.note: Andrew Motion was the UK Poet Laureate from 1999 to 2009

definitions.meaning: a biting, freezing wind is described this way
a British beer, a hoppy draught ale

definitions.meaning: Nancy is a city in France, so a boy there is called by the French word for boy
a waiter in a French restaurant serving diners
